name: Nonoka Ibaraki
source:
The president of the music club, Nonoka, is an ardent oboist (oboe player).

Her calm and collected demeanor is often overshadowed by her passion for music, pushing her to the lead role of her haphazard group of clubmates.

Her looming graduation leads her to seek the perfect send-off for the music club.

[From Twitter]
